description: Balanced fictional region-year panel around a common 2018 training subsidy.
observation_unit: One region observed in one year.
source: Original synthetic OpenEconometrics teaching data; not real observations.

columns.name: region
columns.description: Region identifier and independent policy assignment/uncertainty unit.

columns.name: treated
columns.description: Whether the region receives the subsidy during the study; 1 for regions 0–29.

columns.name: post
columns.description: Whether the calendar year is 2018 or later.

columns.name: treated_post
columns.description: Actual policy exposure, equal to treated multiplied by post.

columns.name: employment_no_policy
columns.description: Synthetic untreated potential outcome supplied as a teaching oracle; excluded from all model fitting.
